definitions.explanation: An area of specialized knowledge or skill.
One's field of study at university.

notes:
{専門|せんもん} is primarily a noun meaning 'specialty' or 'major.'

Common patterns:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{専門|せんもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to specialize in ~
- {専門|せんもん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: My specialty/major is ~
- {専門|せんもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: specialized/specialist + noun

Related words:
- ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧: specialist, expert
- ⟦{専門学校|せんもんがっこう}→専門学校：04859_senmongakkou⟧: vocational school, trade school
- ⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: specialty store
- ⟦{専門的|せんもんてき}→専門的：15633_senmonteki⟧: specialized, technical (na-adjective)

Note: While {専門|せんもん} can modify nouns directly ({専門|せんもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜), for adjectival use meaning 'specialized' or 'technical,' ⟦{専門的|せんもんてき}→専門的：15633_senmonteki⟧ (na-adjective) is more common.
